def make(n, step, markers):

 for i in range(step-1,n,step):
  g[i]=[8]*n
  for r in range(n): g[r][i]=8

 for c in range(4,7): e[r][c]=2
for r in range(8,11):
 for c in list(range(0,3))+list(range(4,7))+list(range(8,11))+list(range(12,15))+list(range(16,19)):
  e[r][c]=6 if 4<=c<=6 else 3
